160m/80m 冬季大气噪声低，是远距离 DX 的黄金季节。: On 160 m/80 m, atmospheric noise is low in winter — the golden season for long-distance DX.
HF 远距离通信的主要反射层，昼夜都存在。: The main reflecting layer for long-distance HF, present day and night.
「高」指电离强度而非高度。北半球夏季（5–8 月）为高峰，昼夜均可出现，: "High" refers to the intensity of ionisation, not the height. It peaks in the northern-hemisphere summer (May–August) and can appear by day or night,
仅白天存在，夜间与 F2 层合并。: Exists only by day; at night it merges with the F2 layer.
仅白天存在，强烈吸收中波与短波低频段信号，日落消失。: Exists only by day; strongly absorbs medium-wave and low-HF signals and disappears at sunset.
位于 E 区高度（约 90–130 km）的、电子密度异常高的薄电离团 ——: A thin ionised cloud with abnormally high electron density at E-region heights (about 90–130 km) —
低波段受地波与电离层吸收影响大，需要好天线并耐心守听。: The low bands are strongly affected by ground-wave and ionospheric absorption; they need a good antenna and patient listening.
使用窄带接收、降低本底噪声，弱信号更容易分辨。: Use narrow-band reception and lower the noise floor; weak signals are then easier to distinguish.
信号因多径干涉等因素出现的强弱起伏。: Fluctuations in signal strength caused by multipath interference and similar factors.
反映太阳活动，黑子多时 HF 高波段传播条件改善。: Reflects solar activity; with more sunspots, conditions on the higher HF bands improve.
受 D 层吸收与噪声限制、仍能保证接收质量的最低频率。: The lowest frequency that still gives acceptable reception, limited by D-layer absorption and noise.
可反常反射 50MHz 甚至 144MHz。: and can anomalously reflect 50 MHz and even 144 MHz.
地波已衰减殆尽、天波第一跳尚未落地的环形区域。: The ring-shaped area where the ground wave has died out and the first sky-wave hop has not yet landed.
垂直入射时能被 F2 层反射的最高频率；MUF = foF2 × sec(i)，: The highest frequency reflected by the F2 layer at vertical incidence; MUF = foF2 × sec(i) — the baseline quantity for all propagation calculations.
天波第一跳落地处与发射点之间的地面距离；F2 层单跳最远约 4000 km，E: The ground distance between the transmitter and where the first sky-wave hop lands; about 4000 km maximum for a single F2 hop and about 2000 km for the E layer.
太阳质子事件后高纬极区电离层强烈吸收，跨极 HF 路径数小时至数天中断。: After a solar proton event the high-latitude polar ionosphere absorbs strongly, interrupting transpolar HF paths for hours to days.
对流层/电离层散射、流星余迹等特殊方式。: Special modes such as tropospheric / ionospheric scatter and meteor trails.
日冕物质抛射（CME）抵达后地磁剧烈扰动，按 NOAA G1–G5 分级；G3: Severe geomagnetic disturbance after a coronal mass ejection (CME) arrives, graded NOAA G1–G5; at G3 and above, HF at high and polar latitudes deteriorates badly.
某时刻两点间能被电离层反射的最高频率。: The highest frequency that can be reflected by the ionosphere between two points at a given time.
沿地表传播，用于 LF/MF 及近距离通信。: Travels along the Earth's surface; used on LF/MF and for short-range communication.
灰线（日出日落）时刻是低频 DX 的最佳通联窗口。: The greyline (sunrise/sunset) period is the best window for low-band DX.
约 90–150 km（峰值约 110 km），可反射较低频 HF；偶发 Es: About 90–150 km (peak around 110 km); can reflect the lower HF frequencies; sporadic E can reflect VHF signals.
经电离层反射，是 HF 远距离通信的主要方式。: Reflected by the ionosphere; the main mode of long-distance HF communication.
视距传播，用于 VHF/UHF 及以上频段。: Line-of-sight propagation, used on VHF/UHF and above.
